commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+6' Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes shows a yellow card to Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) for a tough tackle.
90+5' James Rodriguez (Rayo Vallecano) makes a run into the box and gets on the end of a cross, but his well-taken shot crashes into a defender and is cleared away.
90+3' Sergio Guardiola (Rayo Vallecano) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the right post.
90+1' The attendance is 21112.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
89' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
86' The ball squirts out to James Rodriguez (Rayo Vallecano) inside the box, and his first-time drive beats the keeper but fails to find the net as it's amazingly blocked on the line by a defender.
83' Paulo Pezzolano decides to make a substitution. Selim Amallah will be replaced by Ivan Sanchez (Valladolid).
83' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) comes onto the pitch so that Unai Lopez can be given a rest.
82' The foul by Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes.
80' 1 - 2 Goal 1:2! Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) taps home from close range after the rebound fell kindly into his path.
80' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) with a powerful header hits the post.
79' The linesman makes the right call and Rayo Vallecano will have a corner.
77' The substitution is prepared. Sergio Guardiola (Rayo Vallecano) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Isi Palazon.
77' Inigo Perez has decided to make a change. James Rodriguez (Rayo Vallecano) replaces Sergio Camello.
75' Lucas Rosa (Valladolid) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Augusto Batalla has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
74' Rayo Vallecano have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
73' Abdulay Juma Bah (Valladolid) connects with a precise cross from the corner kick, but his close -range header hits one of his teammates and thus the score doesn't change.
73' It will be a corner kick for Rayo Vallecano.
72' Valladolid failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
68' A corner kick by Rayo Vallecano is thwarted by the well prepared Karl Hein (Valladolid).
68' That will be all from Amath Ndiaye who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Anuar (Valladolid).
66' A player from Rayo Vallecano commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
66' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Rayo Vallecano will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
64' Rayo Vallecano can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
63' Inigo Perez prepares a substitution. Adrian Embarba is replaced by Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano).
63' Today's match ends for Oscar Valentin who will be replaced by Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano).
62' David Torres (Valladolid) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
61' Rayo Vallecano will take a corner kick.

54' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Rayo Vallecano.

48' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Valladolid.

45' Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) is penalised for holding. Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes signals a set piece.
45' Valladolid fail to score from a corner as Augusto Batalla (Rayo Vallecano) leaps to collect the ball.
45' A lofted cross from Luis Perez (Valladolid) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. Valladolid have a corner.
39' Eray Comert (Valladolid) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and has an effort on goal. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies inches high over the bar.
34' Paulo Pezzolano is stunned as referee Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
32' Juanmi Latasa (Valladolid) picks up a yellow card.
32' An attempted cross from Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) is cleared.
31' Rayo Vallecano can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

30' Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The referee signals a corner kick to Rayo Vallecano.
29' Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
29' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) hammers the ball from far out, but his shot is blocked by an opposition player.
26' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) receives a pass and decides to smash the ball from long range. His poor effort sails well wide of the right post.
24' Valladolid take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
24' Lucas Rosa (Valladolid) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The referee points to the corner flag and Valladolid will take a corner.

23' Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
22' The ball finds it way to Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) inside the box and his first-time shot flies a whisker past the right post.
20' Today's referee Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes rightly decides to book Eray Comert (Valladolid) for his harsh tackle.
18' Rayo Vallecano quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

18' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Karl Hein stops the ball from going inside right post. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano have been awarded a corner kick.
17' Selim Amallah (Valladolid) controls the ball after receiving a cross, but he slices his shot well wide of the left post.
13' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano) heads on.
13' Rayo Vallecano work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

13' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger. Rayo Vallecano force a corner. They send men into the box.
12' The resulting set piece from Rayo Vallecano is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. Rayo Vallecano will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
12' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Rayo Vallecano.
10' Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
9' Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) blasts the ball high over the crossbar.
6' A cross is whipped into the centre of the box towards Amath Ndiaye (Valladolid). He gets a good contact on the ball but heads it high over the bar.
6' The linesman raises his flag. Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano) is adjudged offside.
4' Handball by Juanmi Latasa (Valladolid).
3' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) shoots from the free kick towards the goal, but mishits the shot as it goes high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty!
1' The first half has just begun.
